GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination of the mare, which was dragged down, revealed it to have sustained lacerations to its near-hind leg. Trainer was advised a veterinary clearance would be required prior to race or trial. In the days subsequent, trainer reported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the mare. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & weakened in straight. Vetted clear. # Struggled from turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards acceded to a late gear request to remove the Norton Bit and apply a Lugging Bit. Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55kg. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare which weakened in the straight revealed no abnormalities.
